ItemID: 1; Title: TP-Link 24 Port Gigabit Ethernet Switch | Desktop/ Rackmount | Limited Lifetime Protection | Plug & Play | Shielded Ports | Sturdy Metal | Fanless Quiet | Traffic Optimization | Unmanaged (TL-SG1024S); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need to connect enough wired devices to justify 24 ports.
ItemID: 2; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My storage purchases have focused on removable camera and tablet cards, and I am not planning an internal drive upgrade.
ItemID: 3; Title: TP-Link TL-SG108 | 8 Port Gigabit Unmanaged Ethernet Network Switch, Ethernet Splitter | Plug & Play | Fanless Metal Design | Shielded Ports | Traffic Optimization | Limited Lifetime Protection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Expanding a wired network does not address a current need for my camera, tablet, or accessory setup.
ItemID: 4; Title: CyberPower CP1350PFCLCD PFC Sinewave UPS System, 1350VA/880W, 12 Outlets, AVR, Mini-Tower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought surge protectors, but I do not currently need a large battery backup system.
ItemID: 5; Title: SanDisk 256GB Extreme microSDXC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - Up to 160MB/s, C10, U3, V30, 4K, A2, Micro SD - SDSQXA1-256G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I frequently use memory cards, so I would choose this for more removable storage after checking my device supports its capacity.
ItemID: 6; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I own viewing equipment, but I have no immediate need for another HDMI cable or this particular length.
ItemID: 7; Title: Cable Matters 10Gbps 5-Pack Snagless Short Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 ft (Cat 6 Cable, Cat6 Cable, Internet Cable, Network Cable) in Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A pack of short network cables would not help with my current charging, camera, or memory-card needs.
ItemID: 8; Title: UGREEN SD Card Reader USB 3.0 Card Hub Adapter 5Gbps Read 4 Cards Simultaneously CF, CFI, TF, SDXC, SDHC, SD, MMC, Micro SDXC, Micro SD, Micro SDHC, MS, UHS-I (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already bought a UGREEN reader for SD and microSD cards, and I do not currently need the additional formats.
ItemID: 9; Title: Amazon Basics 5-Pack RJ45 Cat 6 Ethernet Patch Cable, 1Gpbs Transfer Speed, Gold-Plated Connectors, 5 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not setting up wired networking, so I would leave this cable pack unchosen.
ItemID: 10; Title: Western Digital 250GB WD Blue SN550 NVMe Internal SSD - Gen3 x4 PCIe 8Gb/s, M.2 2280, 3D NAND, Up to 2,400 MB/s - WDS250G2B0C; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no planned computer upgrade or confirmed compatible M.2 slot, so this is not useful to me right now.
